item.tib: yi dam stag la phur shams can gyi skyabs 'gro dang gsol 'debs
item.coloph: de ltar skyabs sems gsol 'debs 'di ni mkha' 'gro dbang mo g.yung drung dpal ldan sogs kyis bskul ngor / gsang sngags gling pas bris pa'o//
